What matters is that you can sit credibly in two rooms: the commercial conversation with senior business leaders, and the technical conversation with the people who will integrate. Most of all, you'll make sure every deal grows WGSN's relationship with the client, protects the subscription business underneath it, and keeps our intelligence clearly credited to WGSN. You'll report to the VP, working closely with our global commercial leadership, and you'll help raise the commercial standards of the wider North America sales team. jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Planning
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. jobs.title: Team Lead - Perception
jobs.description: Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Perception Build and lead the team that teaches SE3's autonomous systems to see, and ship perception that holds up on real missions. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. About the Role As Perception Team Lead , you'll own SE3's perception stack end to end: the technical roadmap, the architecture and the core algorithmic decisions behind object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation. You'll hire and grow the team, set the engineering bar and stay hands-on, working closely with our founders and autonomy engineers as systems move from recorded data to field trials. What you build decides how well our platforms understand the world around them in real operations. What You’ll Work On Perception Roadmap: Own the technical roadmap for perception, deciding what we build, in which order and how we measure progress. Architecture & Algorithms: Define the architecture of the perception stack and make the core algorithmic decisions across detection, tracking, segmentation and depth. Detection & Tracking: Ship object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data from our autonomous platforms. jobs.title: Change & Go-to-Market Commercial Manager – D2C
jobs.description: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist | DE
jobs.description: Who we are At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution. Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization. That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled. Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai. Your role supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering. As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next. You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization

jobs.description: Établissement : IMT Mines Albi, France École doctorale : Mécanique, Énergétique, Génie civil et Procédés (MEGEP), Université de Toulouse Laboratoire de recherche : RAPSODEE – IMT Mines Albi – UMR CNRS 5302, France Encadrant : Yasmine Lalau, Mathieu Milhé, Elsa Weiss-Hortala Lieu : Albi (RAPSODEE CNRS–IMT Mines Albi) Financement : DGAC, projet FORCE Date de début : Mars 2026 Description du poste : Ce travail s’inscrit dans le projet FORCE, porté par Airbus Opérations et financé par la DGAC. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité. Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone. Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Bioinformatik - Mikrobiom
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Werkstudent:in entwickelst du die bioinformatische Auswertung für ein Mikrobiom-Unternehmen, das wir gerade aufbauen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Team zusammen und überführst metagenomische Methoden in reproduzierbare Analysen, die wir im Produkt einsetzen können. Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, wie verlässlich wir Mikrobiomdaten auswerten und wie gut sich die Ergebnisse nachvollziehen lassen. Deine Aufgaben Metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten auswerten, von der Qualitätskontrolle bis zur taxonomischen und funktionellen Profilierung. Analysewerkzeuge und Referenzdatenbanken vergleichen und gemeinsam mit dem Team entscheiden, welche Methoden für unsere Fragestellungen geeignet sind. Bioinformatische Pipelines implementieren, testen und dokumentieren, damit sie sich mit neuen Datensätzen zuverlässig ausführen lassen. Analyseergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem wissenschaftlichen Team einordnen und methodische Grenzen sichtbar machen. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang in Bioinformatik, Computational Biology oder einem verwandten Fach eingeschrieben. Du hast bereits selbst metagenomische Sequenzierungsdaten ausgewertet, zum Beispiel in einem Forschungsprojekt, einer Abschlussarbeit oder einem Praktikum. Erfahrung mit Shotgun-Metagenomik ist besonders relevant. Du arbeitest sicher mit Linux und der Kommandozeile und setzt bioinformatische Analysen in Python um. Du kannst erklären, warum du eine Analysemethode gewählt hast, wie du ihre Ergebnisse überprüfst und wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kannst technische und wissenschaftliche Themen auf Englisch besprechen und dokumentieren. Erfahrung mit Workflow-Tools wie Nextflow oder Snakemake sowie mit dem Betrieb von Anwendungen oder Pipelines auf AWS ist ein Plus. Wenn du die bioinformatische Grundlage eines entstehenden Mikrobiom-Unternehmens mit aufbauen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung

jobs.description: Job Description Memimpin seluruh aktivitas Research & Development untuk produk frozen food berbasis daging ayam. Mengembangkan produk baru dan melakukan improvement produk existing sesuai kebutuhan pasar dan strategi bisnis. Mengembangkan formulasi, bahan baku, bumbu, coating, filling, serta parameter proses produksi. Memimpin proses trial dari skala laboratorium hingga produksi massal. Mengoptimalkan rasa, tekstur, penampilan, shelf life, kualitas, dan cost produk. Menyusun dokumen R&D seperti formula, spesifikasi produk, parameter proses, dan laporan trial. Berkoordinasi dengan QA/QC, Production, PPIC, Purchasing, Marketing, dan departemen terkait. Melakukan sensory evaluation dan investigasi masalah kualitas produk. Memastikan produk memenuhi standar keamanan pangan dan regulasi yang berlaku. Memimpin dan mengembangkan kompetensi tim R&D. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknologi Pangan, Ilmu dan Teknologi Pangan, Teknik Kimia, Bioteknologi, atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman minimal 5–8 tahun di bidang R&D/Product Development, dengan minimal 2–3 tahun di posisi managerial/supervisory. Diutamakan berpengalaman di industri meat processing, poultry processing, frozen food, atau FMCG. Memiliki pengalaman dalam formulasi dan pengembangan produk olahan daging, khususnya daging ayam. Memahami food processing, sensory evaluation, product costing, GMP, HACCP, dan ISO 22000/FSSC 22000.

jobs.title: Rekrutmen RANS Entertainment Indonesia
jobs.description: PT RANS Entertainment Indonesia Tbk (RANS Entertainment) adalah perusahaan media kreatif, hiburan, dan ekosistem gaya hidup terintegrasi terkemuka di Indonesia. Didirikan pada 27 Desember 2015 oleh pasangan selebritas papan atas, Raffi Ahmad dan Nagita Slavina, nama perusahaan ini diambil dari gabungan inisial nama keduanya. Berawal dari sebuah kanal YouTube keluarga yang mendokumentasikan keseharian, RANS bertransformasi menjadi gurita bisnis berbasis Intellectual Property (IP) yang sangat kuat. Melalui strategi pemanfaatan media digital dan basis penggemar massal, perusahaan ini sukses memonetisasi berbagai sektor industri kreatif dan hiburan tanah air. Saat ini, lini bisnis RANS Entertainment tidak lagi terbatas pada produksi konten digital dan media sosial. Ekosistem bisnisnya telah menggurita ke berbagai pilar strategis, termasuk rumah produksi ( RANS Pictures ), label musik ( RANS Music ), agensi talenta, manajemen acara, hingga industri kuliner (F&B) dan produk konsumen. Tidak hanya itu, RANS juga merambah dunia olahraga profesional dengan mengelola klub sepak bola dan bola basket, serta berinvestasi di sektor pariwisata melalui proyek taman bermain ramah keluarga. Lowongan Kerja PT Rans Entertainmen Indonesia Tbk RANS Entertainment Saat ini RANS Entertainment memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1.
